readings: For each patient, compute their ratio as the average of the row-level HGB/HCT ratios across their Laboratory records, skipping rows where HGB or HCT is missing (or HCT is zero). Compute the cross-patient average as the mean of these per-patient ratios. Keep the patients whose ratio is strictly above that average. Return one summary row with: the mean of these patients' average PIC (each patient's PIC averaged over their records with non-null PIC), the mean of their ratios, and the mean of (patient ratio minus the cross-patient average) for them.

For each patient, compute their ratio as their average HGB divided by their average HCT across their Laboratory records, ignoring missing values (the ratio of the averages, not the average of row-level ratios). Compute the cross-patient average as the mean of these per-patient ratios. Keep the patients whose ratio is strictly above that average. Return one summary row with: the mean of these patients' average PIC (each patient's PIC averaged over their records with non-null PIC), the mean of their ratios, and the mean of (patient ratio minus the cross-patient average) for them.
queries:
WITH pr AS (
    SELECT ID,
           AVG(HGB * 1.0 / HCT) AS ratio,
           AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0
    GROUP BY ID
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM pr
),
pic AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE PIC IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT AVG(pic.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic,
       AVG(pr.ratio) AS mean_ratio,
       AVG(pr.ratio - overall.avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio_diff
FROM pr
CROSS JOIN overall
LEFT JOIN pic ON pic.ID = pr.ID
WHERE pr.ratio > overall.avg_ratio;
WITH per_patient AS (
    SELECT ID,
           AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / AVG(HCT) AS ratio,
           AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) <> 0
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM per_patient
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic,
       AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio,
       AVG(p.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS mean_diff
FROM per_patient p, overall o
WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio;
